en.tagline: The notes of the I. M. Gelfand seminar at Moscow State University, 1964–1989, with a critical companion: every talk summarised, every mathematical item stated precisely with its fate and present status, a problem index across the years, and the bibliography.
en.status_companion: Critical companion: AI-written commentary by {model}, {written}. Mathematical statuses are dated; results marked “proved here” or “computed here” were proved or computed for this companion. Not yet reviewed: every statement, attribution and status in it is the model's own and unchecked.

Scans: MCCME.

en.about_text: The notes are the notebooks of the seminar kept at the MCCME archive (catalogue: {mccme}); the note taker named by the archive is M. A. Shubin. The transcription, the translation and the companion are published in the repository {repo}.
en.corrections_page: Emendations proposed by the companion (mathematical errors faithfully copied from the notebook)
en.speaker_index_text: Every talk by speaker, as named in the companion (or, for years without a companion, in the MCCME catalogue).
en.problems_index_text: Precise questions and conjectures that recur across the years or that later literature took up. A problem met in several chapters is shown once, with the status of its latest entry; every chapter's entry stays visible on its page.
en.references_text: Every work cited by the companion ({n} entries), with the items that cite it. “verified” means the companion's author opened the work.
en.not_found_text: This address is not a page of the site.

This edition is published for educational, non-profit purposes, and we claim no rights we do not hold. If you hold rights in this work and object to its publication here, please open a GitHub issue and we will take it down.

en.notebook_index_text: The Russian diplomatic transcription of the 1,527 notebook pages and its English translation, one page of this site per archive chapter of the MCCME catalogue. Each notebook page shows its number, the number written on it, the scan and the pages of the two PDF readers, the catalogue records on it and the companion items that cite it.

credits_items: Transcription of the 1,527 notebook pages (the Russian diplomatic transcription): GPT-6 Astra (ChatGPT Pro mode).

Editorial work on the transcription and the English translation: GPT-6.1 Sol in Codex, at reasoning effort ultra (every turn of the session record, 6 October to 10 November 2026) and extra high from 11 November 2026 (set by the user; not read from a session record).

Critical companion, one chapter per academic year (22 chapters, 1964–65 to 1988–89): GPT-6 Astra (ChatGPT Pro mode). The chapter for 1983–85 was recovered from an archive the model sent in its answer and rebuilt with the chapter kit; the chapter for 1988–89 is the model's shortened text-only fallback (it typeset no chapter).
Site design: Claude Fable 5.2 at effort high (10 November 2026).
Planning and coordination: Claude Opus 5.5 at effort max (Claude Code).
Site build: Claude Opus 5.5 at effort max (12 November 2026). This rebuild, with all 25 academic years, the companion reader and these credits: Claude Opus 5.5 at effort high (13 November 2026).

On {checked} every item citing a page whose running text changed was compared with the revised text: {u} items were updated to the revised reading and {d} are marked because the revised reading is in question.
